name: -b
options.description: Number the non-blank output lines, starting at 1

name: -e
options.description: Display non-printing characters (see the -v option), and display a dollar sign (‘$’) at the end of each line

name: -l
options.description: Set an exclusive advisory lock on the standard output file descriptor

name: -n
options.description: Number the output lines, starting at 1

name: -s
options.description: Squeeze multiple adjacent empty lines, causing the output to be single spaced

name: -t
options.description: Display non-printing characters (see the -v option), and display tab characters as ‘^I’

name: -v
options.description: Display non-printing characters so they are visible
